description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the CompanyStructureService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods related to company subunit management, such as retrieving, saving, adding, deleting subunits, setting organization name, and fetching subunit hierarchies.

classes.name: CompanyStructureServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the methods of CompanyStructureService, focusing on subunit management within the organizational structure.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of CompanyStructureService, sets up fixture data for tests.

methods.name: testGetSubunitById
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a Subunit object by its ID via the service.

methods.name: testSaveSubunit
methods.description: Tests saving a Subunit object through the service.

methods.name: testAddSubunit
methods.description: Tests adding a new Subunit under a parent subunit via the service.

methods.name: testDeleteSubunit
methods.description: Tests deletion of a Subunit via the service.

methods.name: testSetOrganizationName
methods.description: Tests setting the organization name via the service.

methods.name: testGetSubunitTreeObject
methods.description: Tests fetching the full subunit tree structure.

methods.name: testGetSubunitChainById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the chain of subunit IDs leading to a specific subunit, verifying hierarchical relationships.
